outcome: Surgical complications requiring relaparotomy (hematoma, hemoperitoneum, wound dehiscence, peritonitis)
cohort: Women who underwent Caesarean section at the Clinic of Gynecology and Obstetrics, Clinical Center of Serbia, Belgrade, Serbia, over a 3-year period (2013-2015)
finding: The incidence of relaparotomy following Caesarean section was 0.44%, with indications similar to other tertiary institutions, and no observed mortalities.
